'''Nano-droids''' were a type of microscopic technology that could be used for following targets or as explosives.

==History==
[[Vrath Xizor]] used a solution of tracking nano-[[Droid/Legends|droids]] to follow [[Zeerid Korr]], via them adhering to the bottom of his boot, in [[3653 BBY]].

[[Letta Turmond/Legends|Letta Turmond]] fed nano-droids to her [[Marriage/Legends|husband]], an [[Abyssin/Legends|Abyssin]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] worker named [[Jackar Bowmani/Legends|Jackar Bowmani]], and used him to stage a [[Bombing of the Jedi Temple hangar/Legends|bombing]] of the Temple hanger during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].
